summary: iQSTEL Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Binding Memorandum of Understanding to acquire a 51% controlling interest in ULTRANET Telecom Group. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or closing date are provided. The filing includes a letter to shareholders projecting $4.5M added net income and $9M combined Adjusted EBITDA. The board recommends the transaction; no advisors named. iQSTEL is the acquisition vehicle, financing structure unspecified. Watch for definitive agreement, regulatory approvals, and integration risk given the 51% controlling stake.
